title: Container Bookings: roll compensation before a late SI entry on a rolled booking
content:
## Rule
On a Container Bookings booking the line has rolled, roll compensation comes first. Before a late shipping-instruction submission is recorded on such a booking, this must hold:

> No compensation owed for an earlier carrier roll of the booking remains uncredited.

Only a booking meeting this condition has its late submission recorded; while compensation owed for an earlier carrier roll remains uncredited, the late submission is not recorded.

## Points of judgement
**The booking has never been rolled by the line.** No carrier roll exists, so no compensation for one can remain uncredited.

**A carrier roll is on the booking and its compensation entry already references it.** The condition holds.

**A carrier roll is on the booking and compensation for it is owed but has not been credited.** The condition does not hold, and the late shipping-instruction entry is not recorded.
